book.title: Mɓe ɗe Jesu Kristi woo nJoon ndǝǝn Suun

content: kwoop Naan Ɓe Pal mBabilon
Aɓwoon ɗese, ɓe nghan kǝlǝng mee ɗoo ɗe nǝ kaa ɗoo ɗeɗes, mǝ gurum mo ɗeɗes sǝ nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan. Ɗoo nǝ mo sat nǝnee,

content.text: kǝ iiko mo a mǝ Daa Naan fun.
nǝ azeen, kǝ nǝ a ndǝret.
Wur kǝ canɗyeel ɗebish, mmat ngaa sǝ.
Ɗe gyet war tǝkook yil nǝ shi ngaa war sǝ.
wur ɗe gyet war twe mo.>>

content: Kǝzak, mo waa baa fwo or shiɓal nǝnee,
Nennan ɗe laarvǝl baafeer sǝ mo, kǝ mbii ɗefeer ɗe mo kǝ seen sǝ mo, mo kurum nyil, kǝ mo seyil ɗe nNaan, ɗe wur tong a peetong mǝ mulki. Mo seyil nwur, mo sat nǝnee, <<Nǝ aa sǝ! Kwoop Naan!>>
Ɗangɓe mee ɗoo jì put ɗe nɗǝǝn peetong mǝ mulki nǝ nǝnee,

content.text: nen ɗeɗyeen mo, kǝ nen ɗenan mo jir.>>

content: Ɗangɓe wen kǝleng mee mbii kaa ɗoo kǝ gurum mo ɗes sǝ, nǝn nciit kǝ wal kǝ am ɗǝɗes, ɗe nii sham ndang, kǝ nǝ wal kaa nluu ɗe nii pet sǝ. Ɗoo nǝ mo sat nǝnee,

content.text: Mɓeeɗe Daa Naan fun ɗeɓal jir,
Wu yit kǝ mǝ cin retnyit shi pǝtuup ɗeɓang,
wu yit kǝ mǝ shin ɗeɗes nwur.
Mɓeeɗe pee nǝ wul, ɗe Laatǝm kǝ Naan wur ncìnɗyik.
Matpoo nǝ war kǝ ɗak seet mbǝ ɗyik nǝ.
Mo shin lée ɗepiyaa peng-peng mo nwar,
moo kám a ɗak ɗeret ɗe nen Naan ɗe pang mo kǝ ten cin.)

content: Ɗangɓe ngulep Naan wur sat nghan nǝnee, <<A ran ɗesǝ. Ɗeret nkaa nen ɗe mo pǝrep mo mbǝ se serǝɓet mǝ Laatǝm nǝ.>> Ngulep Naan wur waa baa sat nghan nǝnee, <<Ɗese nǝ a pwoo Naan azeen-nzeen.>>

Wen saam nyil ntoom wur, mbǝkǝ nghan seyil ɗi nwur, mbǝ wur sat nghan nǝnee, <<Taji a cin mǝnǝ kas, nghan a kǝrem Naan kaa waa sǝ, <<kǝ koor ɗyemnǝǝn fun ɗe mo lap langteng mǝ Jesu sǝ. A seyil a nNaan. Pwoo ɗe Jesu wur woo nǝ, a nǝ a káa riin nensatpwoo Naan mo.>>
Jeplek Ɗe a ƊengnaanMo Se Koorong nKaaLuwa Yil Nǝ
Wen naa Ɗengnaan a wuwang, ɓe mee bǝring ɗepiyaa ɗe nii ɗar a kyen fen, ɗe sǝm kǝ gwar ɗe wur lang bǝring ɗepiyaa nǝ a Ngwe ɗe ndǝre, kǝ Nguzeen. Wur canɗyeel a ndǝǝn ar ɗe ndǝre, kǝ cin lek zak.
Yit wur mo a kaa aawus sǝ, kǝ wur kǝ mbiikáa mǝ mulki mo ɗes nkaa káa wur zak. Wur kǝ mee sǝm ɗe nǝ a rǝran nkaa shin, ɗe baa mee gurum mak man nǝ kas, see a wur shikáa wur ɓejee ɗak.
Wur lep lée ɗe sǝɓen ɗe mo kǝ lep ndǝǝn toom, kǝ sǝm wur nǝ a Pwoo Naan.
Nenlek ɗe mo ndǝǝn ɗengnaan, moo mwaan nɗang wur nkaa bǝring ɗepiyaa-piyaa mo, kǝ mo tap lep a lee lilin ɗepiyaa kǝ ɗeɓang.

Mee kwai ɗesese jì put mpwoo wur. A shi kwai ɗesǝ ɓe wur nsaa gurum ɗe mo nyil nǝ mo shinǝ-shinǝ, <<Wur nse mulki nkaa mo a shi ɗul shool.>> Wur ntǝreng am anab nǝ a peetǝreng anab ɗe nǝ a mǝ tuup Naan ɗeɓal met jir.
Nkaa nlǝr wur, kǝ nkaa cìi wur, ɓe sǝm ɗe nǝ sat nǝnee, <<MISHKOOM MƏ MISHKOOM MO, DAA MƏ DAA MO.>>
Ɓe nghan naa mee ngulep Naan wur ɗar nkaa puus, wur pǝrep nyer ɗe moo yool ncáap shi ɗoo ɗeɗes, nǝnee, <<Wu jì, wu kaat ashak jir, mbǝ gomteer ɗeɗes mǝ Naan.

Mɓekǝ wuu se luwa mishkoom mo ɗi, kǝ luwa ɗenan-nan mǝ nenlek mo, kǝ luwa nen ɗǝnan-nan mo, kǝ luwa mǝ bǝring mo, kǝ mǝ nenlang bǝring nǝ mo, kǝ luwa gurum mo jir, mǝ jeplu mo, kǝ mǝ kǝrem mo, ɗeɗyeen, kǝ ɗenan.>>
Wen naa luwayil sǝ, kǝ mishkoom mǝ yil nǝ mo, kǝ nenlek mo mo, mo kuur ashak, mbǝkǝ mo cin lek ɗi kǝ ngulang bǝring ɗepiyaa sǝ, kǝ nenlek wur mo.

Mbǝ mo yaa luwayil nǝ ashak kǝ ngusatpwoo Naan mǝ ɗung sǝ, ɗe gyet wur cin mbii aapwoo, kǝ mbiinaaman mo a pee mǝ luwayil nǝ. A shi mbii aapwoo ɗesǝ mo, ɓe gyet wur num nen ɗe mo lap mbiinaaman mǝ luwayil nǝ, kǝ gyet mo seyil muriin wur zak. Mo vwet mo weet mmeen nɗǝǝn aawus ɗe nii lap a shi fwat mǝ bintǝka.
Mo twe koor nǝ mo shi kwai ɗe nǝ jì put pwoo kǝ ngulang bǝring ɗepiyaa sǝ. Nyer mo jir, mo se luwa nǝ, mbǝ nǝ mak mo.
